name: Locksmiths & home security (category guide)
summary: 24hr lockout quotes vs landlord key rules — digital lock installs in rentals, scam callouts, and when condo MA / police reports matter.
body: Expat lockouts and digital-lock upgrades collide with tenancy rules: many TAs forbid changing cylinders without landlord consent, and condo MAs may restrict common-lobby access devices. 24-hour WhatsApp locksmiths are a classic bait-and-switch forum story — demand a written call-out fee, proof of company registration, and a second quote before night surcharges balloon. After a break-in, photograph damage, notify the landlord/MA, and file a police report before reimbursements. Digital locks and CCTV installs need power, Wi-Fi, and exit planning for deposit return. Distinct from handyman listings that cover general trades. This is a category guide, not a ranked locksmith list.
